```{python}
#| context: setup

from shiny.express import ui, input, session
from shiny import reactive

from app_data import DATA
from shell import build_shell
```

```{python}
#| panel: fill
#| echo: false
ui.HTML(build_shell(DATA.meta))
```

```{python}
#| echo: false
@reactive.effect
async def _push_payload():
    ready = input.client_ready()
    if ready is None:
        return
    filters = input.filters()
    try:
        payload = DATA.payload(filters)
    except Exception as exc:  # pragma: no cover - se informa en la interfaz
        await session.send_custom_message(
            "app_error", {"message": f"No se pudieron aplicar los filtros: {exc}"}
        )
        return
    await session.send_custom_message("app_payload", payload)
```
